name: a pricing cache with named tests and a migration the body skips

pr.title: Cache the pricing table in memory
pr.body: The pricing table was read from the database on every quote. It is now loaded once at boot and refreshed every five minutes. Added unit tests for the refresh timer and ran the quote suite locally.

name: a flag rename that covers every file and says how to roll back

pr.title: Rename --dry to --dry-run
pr.body: Renames the --dry flag of the import command to --dry-run, to match the export command. The old --dry keeps working for one release and prints a deprecation warning, so scripts have time to move. Updated the CLI docs and the flag test, and ran the CLI suite locally.
